overview: For generations, seemingly all paths led through Chicago as trains carrying passengers, livestock, and freight crisscrossed the country. In a new WTTW special and companion website, Riding the Rails, lifelong train enthusiast Geoffrey Baer hops aboard all kinds of trains to tell the story of this essential mode of transport and how it shaped our city. Along the way, he uncovers clues all around us to railroads of the past, recalls the colorful characters who built them and the unsung workers who toiled on them, and reveals why our current rail system is just as vital to Chicago’s existence today.

title: The LandLords
overview: The LandLords

title: The Daoxian Incident
overview: The result of years of fieldwork and research, "The Daoxian Incident" examines the causes of armed struggle and mass killings in Dao County, Hunan, at the height of the Cultural Revolution. Between August 13 and October 17, 1967, 7,696 people were killed and 1,397 were forced to commit suicide. An additional 2,146 were permanently injured or disabled. Most of the victims were labeled “class enemies” and belonged to the so-called “Five Black Categories,” while at least 14,000 people participated in the killings. Through interviews with survivors, participants, and family members, this documentary reconstructs the complex sequence of political campaigns that culminated in one of the bloodiest episodes in the PRC's history.

title: Sympathy
overview: A man tries to come to terms with a crime he committed

title: AEW Dynasty 2026
overview: Dynasty 2026 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on April 12, 2026, at Rogers Arena in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The show was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Kenny Omega for the AEW World Championship, dubbed "The Devil vs. The God of Pro Wrestling."

title: Ten Thousand Reasons for Revenge
overview: After a struggling single mom's daughter takes money from a dying bank robber, the two become entangled in a tense investigation that threatens everything they love.

title: Johnny Bronson
overview: A rage-bait streamer is reached out to by next-door neighbor, forcing him to confront his views on humanity. Also he's an alien from outer space sent to get humanity to destroy itself, so conflict is inevitable.

title: BRAINBUGS
overview: A food delivery driver is reluctantly dragged into the middle of a criminal plot. When the job goes wrong, quick thinking and smart talking are the only tools protecting him from his captor, and an increasingly uncertain fate.

title: Legends of the Lost Ark
overview: Chronicles archaeologist Dr. Chris McKinny’s search for the Ark of the Covenant. Supported by insights from scientists, historians, and biblical scholars, he explores three ancient legends pointing to final resting place of the iconic relic.

title: Our Song
overview: Through the highs and lows of life, Hank and Sarah's love story is forever tied to their special song. What begins as a tune that sparked their love becomes a bittersweet echo of what was. Some songs never end - even when love does.

title: Jerry the Ginger Eater
overview: A man who eats red-headed women befriends a sex worker in hopes to eat her red-headed lady pimp.

title: Paid For
overview: A woman pays for an hour in a hotel room, but not for what you’d expect. What unfolds between two sisters is a confrontation neither of them is ready for.

title: MLW & NJPW Present CMLL Fantastica Mania USA 2026
original_title: MLW & NJPW Present CMLL Fantastica Mania USA 2026
overview: Fantastica Mania USA 2026 was a professional event co-produced by American promotion Major League Wrestling (MLW), Japanese promotion New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) and Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial De Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on April 12, 2026 at Festival Hall in Charleston, South Carolina, USA.

title: Brad Williams: Live on Short Street
original_title: Brad Williams: Live on Short Street
overview: Brad Williams is back with his fourth stand-up comedy special LIVE ON SHORT STREET!  A fearless, high-energy hour packed with outrageous true stories, brutally honest observations, and nonstop laughs from one of the most electrifying comedians in the world.  Filmed live in front of a sold-out crowd in Lexington, KY, Brad dives into everything from relationships, marriage, and fatherhood to disability, sex, therapy, and the absurd realities of modern life. With razor-sharp punchlines and explosive storytelling, this special proves why Brad continues to sell out theaters around the globe.

title: Wait and Remain
overview: Eddie Reyes wakes in an unfamiliar room with no memory of how he got there. Guided by an unnerving presence, he's drawn through fragments of his life in a space that defies explanation. As reality fractures, Eddie must face who he's been, and who he might become.

title: Betty St. Clair
overview: When an anxious Chinese American drag queen hosts an all-AAPI showcase for an unconventional audience, a surprise guest sends her spiraling into self-doubt. Meanwhile, backstage shenanigans from her chaotic drag family threaten to derail the whole show.

title: Void
overview: Because of the constant rumbling of his stomach, Baran becomes estranged from his social circle and loses his job. When he returns to see the doctor, Havin takes a close interest in the sounds coming from his stomach, and the story begins to unfold in entirely unexpected directions.

title: Demonetize
overview: Out-of-work television ghost hunters discover the key to getting their jobs back - and proving ghosts are real - is by working with the last group of people anyone would expect: Social Media Stars.

title: Death Of The Author
overview: When pure madness is mixed with our reality...

title: ROB
overview: ROB, a young LA native, moves to Portland for school, only to drop out almost immediately and settle into a comfortable routine of doing absolutely nothing. What follows is a mostly self-inflicted journey through failure, small awakenings, and the long road to becoming a barely functional adult.

title: A Light Into A Void
overview: After discovering eleven Hi-8 tapes recorded by his late father, filmmaker Lin Chen uses his father’s original DV camera to recover their fragile images and sounds. Interweaving this family archive with 16mm and Super 8 footage, the film explores grief, memory, and the ways recording media preserve and reshape the past.

title: The Grossfarken and the Boy
overview: Despite stories of a monster upstream, a young village boy ventures into the creek and discovers the truth behind his town's lore.

title: Cockroach
overview: Beth and Sergio are ecstatic to begin their journey as new parents. However, caring for a baby with its many sleepless nights proves to be a challenge to their relationship and sanity. Not to mention a cockroach infestation within their walls. They struggle with the tribulations of parenthood and postpartum as the roaches infest their home, their lives and eventually much, much more...

title: A Little Park Music
overview: When a piano appears in the park gazebo, interfering with important work, city manager Allie joins forces with rookie cop Ryan to remove it, only to find both music and love are hard to resist.

title: Bee My Love
overview: Private chef Hannah Jones, competing for her dream job with a celebrity restaurateur, finds inspiration in her mother’s recipes, the sweetness of honey, and a struggling beekeeper who teaches her to believe that life, and love, are sweetest when shared.

title: I Have to Kill My Neighbor
original_title: I Have to Kill My Neighbor
overview: Lauren’s idyllic suburban life is shattered when her husband, Tom, is kidnapped. His anonymous captors give Lauren a strange ultimatum: she must kill Madeline - the next-door neighbor that Lauren despises.

title: Heavy Healing
overview: Much like Rock ‘n’ Roll before it, heavy, aggressive music, including, but not limited to Heavy Metal, Punk, Hardcore and underground Hip-Hop, has gotten a bad rap since inception. Be that as it may, many who have been impacted by a wide variety of enervating conditions have come to rely on the output of heavy artists to successfully assist them through severe illness, weighty medical conditions, as well as debilitating mental health challenges. Heavy Healing seeks to dispel rumors and shine a much-deserved light on the healing powers of aggressive music. You will hear directly and candidly from artists, fans and industry types; remarkable individuals who have leaned on (or even become) “controversial” music makers in order to inspire and be inspired through the grueling process of recovery from the grips of cancer, anxiety and depression, strokes, heart attacks, cerebral palsy, complex blood diseases, juvenile diabetes and HIV/AIDS to name a few.

title: Too Romantic
overview: In a glossy rom-com world, Samantha Carr is a struggling influencer known for her anti-love love songs and carefully curated online persona. When she collaborates with viral creator Mac Mayhew, their instant chemistry turns a songwriting session into an unexpectedly perfect date. But after an awkward and emotionally confusing sexual experience, Samantha’s world begins to crack, forcing her to question whether she’s chasing real connection - or if it’s all just for show.

title: Bleeding Edge
overview: A young Korean-American figure skater must bear the tough-love parenting of her mother, the mind games of her coach, and her own insidious self-doubt as she recovers from an injury.

title: TNA Rebellion 2026
overview: The 2026 Rebellion is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on April 11, 2026, at the Wolstein Center in Cleveland, Ohio. It will be the eighth event under the Rebellion chronology and will feature wrestlers from WWE's NXT brand due to the ongoing partnership between the two promotions.

title: LIMINAL
overview: LIMINAL tells the story of Vincent Marcum, a world-renowned quantum physicist who lost his wife and daughter in a tragic accident in 2001. Once a towering figure in the scientific community, Vincent has since withdrawn from the world, isolating himself in relentless pursuit of a singular goal, bending time itself. For decades, he has obsessively dedicated his life to achieving the impossible: time travel. Now, in the year 2053, at 86 years old, he finally succeeds. But in his research, he uncovers a disturbing truth: time does not curve as once theorized; it moves in a straight, unyielding line. This revelation carries terrifying implications...  ﻿What happens when you travel back to the past and no one was there?

title: Hands On
overview: The final two contestants in a Hands On A Hardbody competition are forced to find common ground when the challenge takes an unexpected turn.

title: Everkeep
overview: A haunting and tender fable of innocence, wonder, and the passage of time, "Everkeep" follows Odette, a lonely girl who dwells in the vast, enchanted expanse of a castle garden. Wrapped in her own world, she clings to childhood magic, convinced she can remain in this place forever.

title: Waiting for Vera
overview: A lone, elderly oil painter prepares to begin a new painting. After readying his materials, he waits for a final, key ingredient.

title: My 7 Grandmas
overview: 17-year-old Gigi (Kate Larson) moves with her mom (Candace Kirkpatrick) from California to small-town Minnesota, where she cleverly plots to help her Grandpa (comedian Jeff Allen) get his life back on track after the loss of his wife.

title: Meat
overview: A doting wife, a controlling husband, and an appetite for revenge.

title: Sherman Park
overview: A group of Black teens try to survive a grisly encounter in Sherman Park.

title: Before Death Do Us Part
overview: Josh, a 20 year old, is at his 3 year mark of a relationship with his girlfriend, Jules. After having doubts for a while, Josh tries to initiate a breakup but is soon interrupted by a serial killer couple named the Pembertons who put both of them in a deadly game of cat and mouse, to force them to love each other once more.

title: Spit Out Your Bones
overview: A Filipino-American college baseball pitcher navigates parental and physical pressures as he prepares to lead his team to a long-awaited championship.

title: The Man Milker
overview: A man must face his greatest fear.

title: Injured?
overview: Need help? Crashouts, manifestation influencers and injury lawyers collide in this breakneck ride through the Midwest. 50 years after attorney ads were first legalized in the United States, their ubiquitous self-portraits (allegedly) invoke a churn-and-burn economy of volume, velocity, fears, and veneers.

title: This is Football
overview: Set against the backdrop of a football-obsessed culture, This is Football dives into the personalities, chaos, and absurdity that orbit the sport. As rivalries intensify and egos clash, the line between competition and spectacle begins to blur.

title: Mr. Silhouette
overview: Jacob sets out to steal a Tesla, unaware that someone is already inside. When he becomes trapped with a man known as Mr. Silhouette, he realizes he isn't pulling a job - he's the job.

title: When We Dream Of Rockets
overview: An experimental film about the morality of space travel, based on a child’s dream

title: See You When I Get Back
original_title: See You When I Get Back
overview: Inspired by grindhouse cinema and low-budget horror of the 1970s, LA’s Inner Wave present their first feature film, See You When I Get Back. Starring the band, the film follows a struggling group on the brink of burnout, whose pursuit of success takes a supernatural turn. When the band’s frontman discovers a mysterious orb capable of granting three wishes, their dreams suddenly feel within reach—until he realizes every wish comes with a terrifying cost. What unfolds is a comical yet horrifying descent into ambition, consequence, and the price of getting what you want.

title: Foil and Doo: A Tale of Two Jokers
original_title: Foil and Doo: A Tale of Two Jokers
overview: Foil and Doo are two clowns working a dead-end job in a supermarket. One day, they decide to branch out and go to Clowns Anonymous, where the leader is secretly working for the Clown Bureau of Investigation and recruits the two clowns.

title: Burnout
overview: A young man spirals through nicotine addiction in reverse, uncovering how one moment with a girl led him to his lowest point.

title: Chugwater, Wyoming
overview: In the town of Chugwater, Wyoming, a man finds himself in the center of a U.S. missile attack. Very quickly, he discovers that it's entirely his fault.

title: i'm sorry, aidan.
overview: A prestigious short film circling the (fake) ending of a friendship.

title: Man-O-Wolf: The Axe Wielding Werewolf from Hell
original_title: Man-O-Wolf: The Axe Wielding Werewolf from Hell
overview: A werewolf slasher film created by prolific underground filmmaker Sam Hel.

title: Injustice
overview: A man try’s to find his best friend murderer in this shocking tale.

title: Time Life Volume 9. Life Model
overview: The mechanical gaze of a book scanner becomes a hyper-speed collage of anatomy.

title: Solace
overview: A teenage boy struggling with depression reaches the tipping point as he remembers the simple but powerful moments in his life.

title: Come Talk To ME
overview: Imagine you have a disease likely to leave you unable to talk or write. “Come Talk To ME” shows Parkinson's disease (PD) activist Jackie Christensen, husband Paul and friends with PD reflecting on how it has affected their own  speech and relationships.

title: Double act
overview: Two acts take place at once.

title: HOT!
overview: A mother penguin and her daughter are driving under the scorching summer sun to an amusement park. When they start fighting over the air conditioning, they end up breaking it, turning the ride into a little adventure.

title: On tape
overview: The final bit of tape billows about as Locky holds the roll.

title: Nobody Knows Me
overview: Nobody knows me nobody knows me nobody knows me like you know me

title: Gold leaf
overview: Glinting surface washed up on the shore.

title: Bottle highlight
overview: Fluid finds its way around a bottle.

title: Toe poke
overview: A toe pokes a container full of liquid.

title: Silver roll
overview: Reflective garbage walks along the beach.

title: Exit 8
overview: A man trapped in an endless sterile subway passageway sets out to find Exit 8. The rules of his quest are simple: do not overlook anything out of the ordinary. If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?

title: Thrash
overview: When a catastrophic hurricane slams a coastal town, stranded residents must survive rapidly rising waters swarming with ravenous sharks.

title: You, Me & Tuscany
overview: When a woman crashes at an empty Italian villa, posing as the owner's fiancée, she discovers an unexpected romance that could transform her life.

title: Beast
overview: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in one championship against the brutal champion Xavier Grau.

title: Infiltrate
overview: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

title: The Christophers
overview: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

title: Faces of Death
overview: A moderator on an internet video-sharing platform stumbles across a potential snuff film ring hidden in the depths of the site's content.

title: Tu Yaa Main
overview: A wannabe rapper from the outskirts of Mumbai and an affluent influencer elope to a coastal town, only to find themselves trapped in the pool of a derelict resort fighting for survival against the wrath of a ferocious crocodile.

title: ChaO
overview: In a futuristic world where humans and mermaids coexist, the life of mild-mannered office worker Stephan is upended when he is suddenly proposed to by Chao — a princess from the mermaid kingdom. With no time to make sense of what's happening, Stephan soon finds himself living with the unpredictable, wholehearted Chao, and her sincere love begins to break down his emotional barriers.

title: Dacoit
overview: Betrayed by his better half, a man is convicted for a crime he didn't commit. Once free, he hunts her down in pursuit of vengeance, as their stories intertwine with a series of robberies.

title: Hamlet
overview: When Hamlet returns for his father’s funeral, he is stunned to discover his uncle Claudius is marrying his newly widowed mother. Visited by his father’s ghost, Hamlet learns his brutal murder was at the hands of Claudius and spirals into a quest for vengeance that exposes the rot at the heart of the family’s empire and threatens his own sanity.

title: Newborn
overview: After serving seven years in solitary confinement, Chris Newborn seeks to rebuild his life and reconnect with his family only to find that freedom has become a terrifying psychological battleground.

title: PH-1
overview: A promising politician is held hostage in his luxurious penthouse by a remote captor, forced to watch his life destroyed by social and conventional media as he tries to figure out who is behind it and why.

title: If I Can't Have You
overview: Lust evolves into obsession when a married man embarks on an affair with a seductive and enigmatic woman who soon realizes he'll never leave his wife.

title: Steal This Story, Please!
overview: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

title: Dead Roommate
overview: Struggling with anxiety and loneliness, college freshman Victor forms an unexpected bond with his new roommate Abbey, who died in the dorm decades earlier. Together, they discover friendship, courage, and the comforting sense of belonging.

title: Worst Contact
overview: Movie night is interrupted by a pesky alien invasion.

title: The Book
overview: Max and Eli lose a rare library book and spiral into increasingly absurd schemes to avoid the quickly mounting late fees.

title: THE EDGE
overview: As tensions erupt worldwide, three black men retreat for a weekend of healing, meditation, and connection.

title: La Partenza
overview: In a peaceful Italian town, a mother prepares her family for a long awaited trip to New York, carrying every responsibility on her own. As the pressure mounts, her inner world begins to fracture, revealing the invisible weight she can no longer hold alone.

title: The Caretaker
overview: After a car accident leaves Miles paralyzed, his wife hires a live-in caretaker who will stop at nothing to become the man of the house.

title: Sasquatch Within
overview: Two assassins awaken trapped in a sealed apartment with one hour left and orders to kill each other. As memory and paranoia return, an ancient legend stirs- summoned by trauma- forcing them to face control, loyalty, and what lives within.

title: Hunting Matthew Nichols
overview: Twenty-three years after her brother mysteriously disappeared on Vancouver Island, a documentary filmmaker sets out to solve his missing person's case. When a disturbing piece of evidence is revealed, she comes to believe he might still be alive.

title: Home Makeover Nightmare
overview: After the sudden passing of her mother, Dayna returns to Los Angeles to sell the family home. She teams up with her old friend, Mike, now a successful real estate agent. As sparks ignite, Mike's obsession with her grows, manipulating every aspect of her life until the home makeover he proposes becomes a nightmare.

title: Journeys
overview: A deep dive into the rapidly expanding world of Psilocybin Psychedelic Therapy. How it's being used in large (Heroic) and microdose form for PTSD, depression, end-of-life care, as well as the science, ethics and structure of the practice.

title: Buttons
overview: Charlie, an eight year old boy, runs away from home into the nearby woods and discovers that his stuffed teddy bear, Buttons, has come to life.

title: The Zoo
overview: A caged lion festers in anger and silence until an unlikely friend comes along to help him tell his story. Poignant and timely, the lion’s story offers a mirror into human nature.

title: Sound Asleep
overview: When an insomniac reaches breaking point, he goes to war with every sound in his home - no matter the cost.  Deen Peels needs sleep, but the world just won't shut up. The ticks, clicks and drips are driving him insane, and the shagging through the walls is just too much. Over one relentless night, he's determined to take back control, even if it kills him. Silence isn't golden; it's war.

title: Egomaniacs
overview: His job interview at stake, Jerry, a reserved man, endures the waiting room with two egomaniacs.

title: Heads or Tails?
overview: When cowboy Billi and his sweetheart Rosa run away together, he is accused of her husband's death and becomes the symbol of a local uprising. Everyone wants his head and only Rosa knows the secret that could finally set them free.

title: Bunnylovr
overview: A drifting Chinese American cam girl struggles to navigate an increasingly toxic relationship with one of her clients while rekindling her relationship with her dying estranged father.

title: The Reunion: Laguna Beach
overview: For the first time in 20 years, original Laguna Beach cast members Lauren Conrad, Stephen Colletti, Kristin Cavallari, Trey Phillips, Talan Torriero, Christina Schuller, Lo Bosworth, Dieter Schmitz, Jessica Smith, Alex Hooser, and Morgan Olsen reunite to relive moments from the show that shaped a generation. Featuring behind-the-scenes stories, cast reactions to iconic episodes, and a return to Laguna Beach, they reflect on the friendships, love triangles, and drama that changed their lives.

title: The Great Warsaw Race
overview: A young jockey Krzysiek dreams of competing in a prestigious race - the Great Warsaw Race. He enters the world of horse racing with the naivety of an enthusiastic newcomer. He quickly realizes though that the racetrack is a web of dependencies, powerful interests, and manipulated results. Krzysiek hopes he can change it. But in a world of corruption and dirty deals it's hard to remain unblemished.

title: Clownspiracy
overview: A small town high school misfit investigates the appearance of creepy clowns before an upcoming election, discovering the clowns are more than they appear.

title: The Unknown
overview: Desperate to cure his writer’s block, Elliott retreats to a remote cabin—only to discover he may not be alone. As the boundaries between his work and his life collapse, Elliott begins to question everything he knows. Is he writing a thriller? Living one? Both?

title: The Witch of Endor
overview: King Saul makes a desperate attempt to save his life by enlisting the Witch of Endor to call up the spirit of the Prophet Samuel for guidance.

title: Shadowing
overview: A college student finds herself being stalked by an uncanny presence.

title: The Magnificent Mendez
overview: Miami heat meets industry cold-blood. When legendary producer Cornelio Mendez's long-lost love suddenly resurfaces, it ignites a high-stakes war for the soul of Leon Studios. In a world of "Adapt or Die," how far will Mendez go to protect his artistic integrity-and his life?

title: Fiume o morte!
overview: Through dramatic reconstruction and documentary asides, the spirit of Italian poet, playwright, journalist, aristocrat and army officer Gabriele D’Annunzio is captured, presenting the nascent fascism in his attempts to forge a new state in the aftermath of the First World War.

title: Missed
overview: June, a 35-year-old woman reeling from a missed miscarriage, returns to her car to find an uninvited passenger: a loud, cheerful puppet named Daisy. What begins as a waking nightmare becomes something unexpected. Daisy shifts from nuisance to companion, helping June navigate grief, logistics, and the impossible pressure to just "get over it." A dark comedy about loss, motherhood, and the strange forms comfort can take.

title: Plastic Sun
overview: A shackled man crawls through the desert in search of water across parched land. Not long after, he meets a tall man who informs him of all the unusual sins he has committed in the past. The tall man disappears, while the shackled man continues on his path, carrying the consequences of his actions on his shoulders.

title: Stop to Stop
overview: Carolyn is flooded with political text messages. When a chance encounter reveals the identity of one of her tormentors, she seeks revenge, but finds a spark.

title: The Bloody Mary
original_title: ブラッディ・メアリー
overview: Betty, an occult-loving girl, and Seeka, a demon, pick up gigs to make some cash. This time, they head into a mansion rumored to be haunted by Bloody Mary... but what’s actually waiting for them inside?

title: Painted Sharks
overview: Carrying the blame for her mother’s pain, Ricki searches for a way out of an abusive family relationship. She and her younger sister face a dilemma no child should… how to get rid of their father?

title: The Princess & The Dragon
overview: A desperate woman navigates a labyrinth of horrors, where every step reveals cryptic messages, hidden dangers, and an axe wielding dragon closing in.

title: An Instrumental Start: A Model for the Nation
original_title: An Instrumental Start: A Model for the Nation
overview: Located in the heart of Miami’s Liberty City, the African Heritage Cultural Arts Center, under the visionary leadership of Marshall Davis Sr., has spent over 50 years shaping young lives through a rigorous and transformative arts education. Its students have gone on to perform on Broadway, win Academy Awards, and appear in films and productions around the world—while others have carried that same discipline and purpose into careers as lawyers, police officers, and community leaders. This film is a powerful testament to the impact of arts education in underserved communities, featuring contributions from Phylicia Rashad, Savion Glover, and Tarell Alvin McCraney, alongside alumni, current students and educators from the Center, and dedicated members of the broader community.

title: The Travel Companion
overview: Simon, a struggling documentary filmmaker, enjoys free flights courtesy of his best friend and roommate, Bruce, who works for an airline. However, when Beatrice, a more successful filmmaker, enters the picture and starts dating Bruce, Simon risks flying too close to the sun.

title: I'll Always Be There
overview: As a man watches his husband’s mind fade, their shadows come to life to reenact cherished memories and spark a final moment of recognition.

title: Hollywood's Mermaid: The Esther Williams Story
original_title: Hollywood's Mermaid: The Esther Williams Story
overview: "Hollywood’s Mermaid" takes a deep dive into Esther William’s remarkable life’s story. We follow Esther from a 16-year-old Olympic hopeful to a 90-year-old Hollywood icon and see first-hand how her unique blend of athleticism, grace, and charisma continually captivated audiences across the globe for decades.

title: Return to Sender
overview: Unassuming and "nice guy" Marshall has his night turned upside down through a series of calls and texts when he finds a lost phone.

title: RMH15: Back To Me
overview: After a summer away, Felix returns to campus with a new mindset, new friends and the same ex boyfriend. After running into each other at a party Montgomery and Felix have to decide if this is love or a thing of the past.

title: The Letter
overview: The Letter follows a recently arrived immigrant and his family as they face an impossible deadline to leave the United States or risk deportation. Told through the lens of the filmmaker’s close friendship with the subject, the film centers on the slow dismantling of the family’s home—an act that becomes both practical and symbolic—capturing fear, love, and resilience as neighbors, church members, and community activists rally together, leaving a visible absence where a family once belonged.

title: Angel's Body Temperature
overview: Aketo is 20 year old college student living in Tokyo. He has an older lover named Hiroshi who lives in Kyoto. One day, Aketo meets a young woman Harumi who is wandering around in Tokyo. Harumi rolls into Akato's house.

title: Sounds of a Factory: WAV to PNG
original_title: Sounds of a Factory: WAV to PNG
overview: Sounds of a Factory: WAV to PNG translates factory recordings sampled from Youtube into visual noise patterns using scripting and databending techniques. Sound is segmented into micro-temporal units and algorithmically reinterpreted as grayscale pixel values. Rather than representing industrial labor, the work reenacts its operational logic: repetition, synchronization and normalization. The pulsating grain and the looping structure situate the viewer inside a rhythmic system in which perception itself becomes a site of power.

title: Ditches & Dreams
overview: In a Baghdad that’s finding its footing again, 19-year-old Yas transforms its cracked asphalt into his skateboard runway, gliding beyond childhood shadows and carving out his horizon.

title: Arrangements for Robotic Arm
overview: Arrangements for Robotic Arm is a series of looping animations composed through repeated acts of computational output, robot-actuated drawing and sequencing. Each segment resolves seamlessly into itself and creates a perfect loop without a fixed beginning or end. Here, repetition functions as both process and subject: every animation begins as a software program whose code is written to run a motion sequence before being brought back to a “zero frame” which enables both the software program and its visual output to repeat in perpetuity. The series approaches repetition as a condition which unfolds in time. Meaning emerges through this consistent and sustained return to an initial form before starting once more.

title: Sink or Sin!
overview: Contestants compete via trivia questions for the chance to win ultimate prizes or meet their untimely demise on on Hell’s top-rated gameshow, “Sink or Sin”. When two siblings are forced to play, their unbreakable bond will change the show forever.

title: is it experimental? number 3
overview: is it experimental? number 3 uses repetition and photographs of the artist’s chaotic and cramped production environment to expose the working conditions that plague experimental filmmakers without access to a professional studio or equipment. The repeated phrase “I can’t work like this” is true, in that the lack of time and resources can indeed limit creativity, but also tongue in cheek, as Pelling and many other artists in a similar position continue to produce important and relevant film and video works under these constraints.

title: Practice Towards Light
overview: In collaboration with painter Yun-hee Huh, this work documents a year-long practice of filming the sunrise through multiple exposures on four 100ft rolls of 16mm film. Each of the four rolls represents a season (fall, winter, spring, summer) with seven separate sunrise shoots layered onto a single roll of film, creating a compressed record of time and light.

title: Stomach, Thighs, and Ass
overview: Stomach, thighs and ass refers to the various sites of the body where I can inject myself with insulin. Every night and every morning, and before every meal, I check my blood sugar level, record it in a notebook and take my insulin. For two years, I have kept a video diary of every single insulin injection. This four-channel video is made up of a selection of those needles, sometimes in the intimacy of my domestic space, sometimes in public, up close and far away, moments of anxiety and moments of calm, these documented injections capture brief glimpses of the fleeting life that surrounds them. In the process, the viewer pays witness to both the exhaustion of living with chronic illness and the quiet stillness that can sometimes accompany it.

title: Dominion

original_title: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans of Reteti
overview: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans of Reteti is set in the wild north of Kenya, where a groundbreaking blueprint in conservation is under way. This touching documentary follows the remarkable journey of orphaned elephants at Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, the first community-owned and -operated elephant sanctuary in Africa. These young elephants, rescued after losing their mothers to accidents, drought, or human-wildlife violence, are raised by Samburu men and women who care for them as their own. They nurture these young elephants with patience, care, and deep ancestral knowledge to get them back on their feet and ready for life in the wild. From tiny calves taking their first bottles from their human carers, to adolescents preparing for release, this film captures the elephants’ intimate moments of struggle, healing, and transformation. It also shows how local community members are creating a unique, thoughtful new model of conservation from the ground up.

overview: Dir. Ken Jacobs. 2025, 48 mins. U.S. Digital. This colorful and cubist record of a Chinatown haircut is the final long-form work by the great avant-garde filmmaker Ken Jacobs, who died last October. As with his first film, Orchard Street (1955), made 70 years earlier, A Date with Shirley is a slice of New York City life that transforms urban energy into cinematic spectacle. Three cameras capture the action, one operated by Ken as he is having his Einstein-ian locks shorn, and the others by his children, Aza and Nisi. A loving and poignant family scene, the film is also a dazzling work of art—and a tribute to a fine barber whose phone number is offered in the credits

title: Action Bog

Time stretches like soft polymer; metamorphoses creep forward frame by frame, suspiciously slow, as if the film were watching me back. Photographic fragments are transferred onto clay, not quite sculpture, not quite collage, but something in between: a Tonermorph. Figures emerge mid-gesture, faces unsealed yet never whole, suspended within the patterns of their own skin. They falter, caught in an action bog of their own making, or perhaps mine. A work of non-narrative cinema, the piece is guided by a score from electroacoustic and musique concrète composer Andrew Zukerman. Created during a 2025 summer residency at the Toronto Animated Image Society, with production funding support from the Society.

title: Missing 411 National Parks: Washington State
overview: Washington State follows investigator David Paulides as he examines a series of unexplained disappearances in and around Mount Rainier and Olympic National Park, where hikers, climbers, and experienced outdoorsmen vanish without tracks, scent trails, or clear cause. Through interviews with families, witnesses, and search personnel the film contrasts known environmental dangers - severe weather, terrain, and hypothermia - with unsettling anomalies. Some of these include aircraft debris fields, unusual patterns in search failures, eyewitness encounters, and reported aerial phenomena dating back to the 1946 Curtis Commando crash and the dawn of the modern UFO era. As grief-stricken families search for closure and investigators compare evidence against established "profile points," the documentary challenges viewers to consider whether these cases can be explained by nature alone - or if something unknown operates within the wilderness.

title: Now, Irving Rapper
overview: Irving Rapper is, in many ways, Hollywood's forgotten man. After getting his start as a "dialogue director" at Warner Bros. in the mid 30's, he became synonymous with the studio's "women's pictures" and rose in prominence as one of Bette Davis's most consistent collaborators, including on her biggest commercial success, Now Voyager (1942). He was a rebel who led the studio in suspensions for chronically refusing to direct the scripts handed to him by the brass, waiting instead for material that better suited his interests and thematic preoccupations. He was also one in a secretive fraternity of gay directors who had to conceal their identities and shield their private lives from potential public ruination. Daniel Kremer takes you through an unexamined and misunderstood life of a man of great artistic inclination who expressed his innermost yearnings covertly through his work in motion pictures.

title: 1000 Women in Horror
overview: Is horror a man’s world? In 2020, award-winning Australian critic Alexandra Heller-Nicholas released the definitive book on the subject: 1000 Women in Horror, 1895–2018, an encyclopaedic work celebrating the many women – filmmakers, actors, producers and technicians – who have shaped the genre since the moment cinema’s light first flickered.

title: A Body to Live In

Blending rare archival footage with the voices of queer and artistic trailblazers, the film shows how pain, ritual, and transformation became tools of identity, survival, and self-expression. Weaving from early experiments and secret gatherings to the emergence of a global subculture shaped by the AIDS crisis and spiritual reinvention, Director Angelo Madsen (NORTH BY CURRENT) reveals not just the story of one artist, but a collective history of bodies in revolt - asking what it truly means to live freely in one’s own skin.

For centuries, archaeologists believed it was a religious center built by nomadic hunter-gatherers before the rise of civilization. This startling discovery could be the missing link in humanity's momentous transition from hunting to farming. Follow experts as they use new digs and shattered skulls to piece together a captivating story that could forever change our understanding of the roots of civilization.

What began as curiosity has hardened into obsession, isolating him from the world around him. When Russ finally uncovers a lead that points to the killer’s hidden lair, the line between hunter and hunted begins to blur. title: Googie
overview: Googie architecture was one of the most visually exuberant and culturally formative design movements of the mid-20th century, yet it remains widely misunderstood. Defined by bold angles, sweeping rooflines, neon signage, and a sense of space-age optimism, Googie transformed everyday buildings into roadside spectacle. Coffee shops, bowling alleys, car washes, banks, and churches were designed not just for function, but to captivate motorists cruising by.  Rooted in Los Angeles, the movement drew inspiration from visionary architects such as Frank Lloyd Wright and John Lautner, while firms like Armet & Davis brought futuristic flair to the commercial landscape. Though many original structures have been lost, preservationists now champion Googie as a serious architectural expression—one that captured the aspirations of postwar America and reshaped the visual identity of the modern city.

title: The Next Act is Freedom

The Next Act Is Freedom is a document of the Resilience Arts Festival in October 2025 — a first-of-its-kind convening of artists impacted by the criminal legal system, presented by Mud Theatre Project and the Chicago Torture Justice Center. Exploring themes of healing and re-entry, the film presents four days of performance and poetry, as well as conversations with police torture survivors, currently incarcerated writers, and abolitionist advocates.  Filmmakers: Mariam Aejaz, Mary Huber, Sumiah Salloum, Toni Smalls, Drew Smalls-Verneau

title: Nothing Planned
overview: Nothing Planned deals in after-images. From the hallucinatory flicker of oscillating film projectors to the apparitions peering back from his found subjects; Lary 7’s audio/visual assemblages imprint on the mind’s eye a picture of what’s “not junk yet”. Built from the workhorses of an image-making industry now gone bloodless, these teetering assemblages whir, tick, slice and warp their own mechanical and optical logic, held together mostly by invention — equally ready to sing as to sputter a last gasp.

title: Analogies
overview: A daring horror-anthology film built from seven segments, each by a different director, unified under the theme of taboo, the body and the repressed. The collection turns its gaze toward the most demonised and fetishised frontier of bodily representation — the anus — and uses this “hidden” territory to explore anxiety, identity, desire, repression and liberation. The stories vary in tone and style—some digital-age allegory, some dream-like psychological journeys, some extreme body-horror—but all form a choral fresco: each segment maintains its individual voice while entering into a dialogue with the others. The project positions itself not simply as provocation but as a political, aesthetic dissection of the obscene, asking where cinema’s boundaries lie, and what is suppressed, shown or revealed.

title: Life Forgotten
overview: Evocative yet playful, Life Forgotten asks, how does everyday entertainment bring people together and act as a catalyst for social change? Situating archival film in parallel with reenactment, the film conjures up New York’s Lower East Side in the early years of the twentieth century, it centers on a real storefront cinema, Frank Seiden’s Variety Theater. Here silent movies were anything but. Frank and his sons improvised dialog for the films and sang Yiddish ballads to an audience that didn’t hesitate to join in or argue back. It was a welcoming space for women and the film follows a group of radical young garment workers who gather here to figure out how to fight for women’s rights and change their world.

title: After the Pleasure Dome

The psychedelic imagery asks: what precious jewels threaten to drown you? Which riches must your expel to survive?

Following the pageant’s centennial, the film tracks Eli Santana, who plays Alessandro, as he investigates the real history behind the fiction, including the 1880s killing of Juan Diego. They seek out descendants of Juan Diego and his wife, Ramona Lubo, and record a new wax-cylinder statement to restore her missing voice. After port-hopping to taste local authentic flavours, the chefs dock back on board to face their biggest hurdle: scaling up their signature dishes alongside the ship's elite crew. Each episode represents a different leg of Chang’s journey, pairing him with a new travel companion and a new culinary adventure.

title: Setting the Tempo
overview: Go inside the exhilarating, high-stakes process of building a WNBA franchise from the ground up.

title: Bucks County, USA
overview: Evi and Vanessa, two 14-year-olds living in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, are best friends despite their opposing political beliefs. As nationwide disputes over public education explode into vitriol and division in their hometown, the girls and others in the community fight to discover the humanity in “the other side.”

title: Heavy Weekend with Jake Hanrahan
overview: Embedded dispatches from your local underground. An Away Days series produced in collaboration with VICE.

title: I Kissed A God And He Became Mine
original_title: I Kissed A God And He Became Mine
overview: Struggling painter Ryan hits rock bottom after being abandoned by his unfaithful ex. Drunk and heartbroken, he kisses an old stone statue and begs for companionship. The statue transforms into Eli, a powerful fallen god bound to him by a soul thread forged three centuries prior. Ryan is the reincarnation of Alai, the painter who sacrificed himself to seal Eli long ago. As they coexist and grow fond of each other, they face threats: vengeful ex Claire, seal keeper Otto, monster Hunter, and the cruel Divine Court Lord who bans mortal-god love. Through memory loss, petrification traps, deadly rituals and countless life-or-death trials, the pair unravel ancient secrets, defeat evil forces, and break the court’s unjust rules. Finally, they abandon divine restraints and embrace an ordinary, warm life together.

title: Flee From Him
overview: Leo, who was imprisoned and tortured to death by the gangster Damian in his previous life, is reborn to save his seriously ill sister and is forced to become Damian's "substitute plaything" again. Under the desperate circumstances of public humiliation, a failed escape, and his sister's "tragic death," Leo resolutely drinks poison, casting the most vicious curse with his life. Three months later, Leo survives but loses his memory. The once-violent Damian hides his fangs, claiming they are a loving couple, and weaves a new cage called "love" with extreme tenderness. Until the blood-stained diary is blown open by the wind, the shocking blood-written word "RUN" awakens the soul-deep fear engraved in his memory.

title: Bully at School, Sugar on Live
original_title: Bully at School, Sugar on Live
overview: Daniel is the invisible, bullied equipment assistant for the ice hockey team, a pitiful bottom who only gets attention and care when he becomes a sexy cam boy late at night. He has no idea that his most hated bully, the school's top alpha who despises gays, is the same person who showers him with money every night as his biggest fan. This is a story of enemies turned lovers, where a straight jock is bent out of shape by the boy he swore to hate.

title: Sicknote
overview:
sicknote follows four bandmates balancing day jobs with their passion for music: free-spirit animation director River, resilient interior designer Delancey, sharp software engineer Lexi, and restless record store associate West.

navigating career ambitions, adulthood, and dating, they support each other through self-discovery and heartbreak to become the world’s biggest band.

title: Addicted to Hate
overview: In a blended family, step‑brother Kyle is consumed by hatred stemming from their parents’ messy past and torments Alex, his step‑brother. Obsessively infatuated with Kyle, Alex endures every humiliation and draws closer to him recklessly. Manipulation from Alex’s mother and fierce family‑fortune conflicts keep stoking their friction. Hatred and desire twist together. Bitter resentment burns hot, yet Alex throws himself into this desperate love. As inheritance chaos erupts, Kyle can no longer hide the forbidden longing growing beneath his hatred.

title: Mad Dog's Leash
overview: Matthew, a gang leader once Hudson’s bodyguard, kidnaps the fallen aristocrat Hudson out of inferiority and obsessive love, locking him in a penthouse with a golden tracking ankle chain. Everyone believes Hudson is a helpless victim, except Matthew’s sharp subordinate Elena, who senses his unnatural docility. The truth reverses everything. Hudson adores Matthew, who once nearly lost his hand protecting him. To escape an arranged political marriage and save Matthew, he sabotages his family’s mafia empire and secretly funds Matthew’s rise. He pretends to be captured on purpose, manipulating Matthew’s possessiveness. After Elena uncovers all evidence, the pair confront each other. They reconcile, eliminate all rivals side by side, and co-rule the underworld, willingly becoming each other’s eternal cage.

title: The God of Desire’s Sinful General
original_title: The God of Desire’s Sinful General
overview: General Ian of Athens was rescued from a desperate situation by Eros, the God of Desire. The two embarked on a forbidden romance that transcended the boundary between gods and mortals. As Athens became engulfed in the flames of war, Eros used his divine power to protect his beloved. He not only unveiled the destined bond between them from a decade ago but also guided Ian through a transformation, helping him defy the oppression and conspiracies of the royal power.

overview: Jani Master returns for an electrifying Grand Launch, as the Star Masters and a new wave of talent set the stage for a season demanding double the skill.

But winning over the terrified townspeople isn‘t going to be easy! To make matters worse, trouble is lurking nearby! Two villainous crocodile and alligator named Chris and Gus are hatching a secret plot to kidnap Tex and destroy the city. With the whole town against them and bad guys closing in, Tyra and Tex must stick together to outwit their enemies and survive the chaos!

title: I Stole The False Heir’s Heart
original_title: I Stole The False Heir’s Heart
overview: Kael returns as the Ashford heir, threatening Rhys’s place. Forced under one roof, rivalry turns into a forbidden love that defies their family.

overview: Mage Elias discovers the Dark Lord is Lucien, his presumed-dead lover. Forced onto opposite sides of war, they choose love over destruction.

title: The Rugged Countryman Awakens: No Longer a Cannon Fodder
original_title: The Rugged Countryman Awakens: No Longer a Cannon Fodder
overview: Framed by the family’s true heir, He Chen is left penniless and takes refuge in Qingshi Village, where he stays with Sheng Mingsui, a rugged, illiterate but kindhearted countryman. As Mingsui falls for He Chen and vows to protect him, he discovers that he is merely a “cannon-fodder” character destined to make way for He Chen’s true love.

title: Marked by the Vampire King
overview: Omega Elian infiltrates the Vampire King’s castle for revenge, only to uncover the truth and fall for Lucius, the tyrant he was meant to kill.

High school student Liam Bennett has been carefully hiding his identity as an Omega. In this world, Omegas are seen as a vulnerable group, and once their identity is exposed, they will become subordinates to Alphas. With the special inhibitors provided by his mother Mara, he disguises himself as a Beta and struggles to lead an ordinary life.

Everything changes the day he collides with Caleb Voss, the most elite Alpha in the whole school, in the hallway. With just a faint trace of scent, Caleb figures out the secret he has concealed for years.

overview: Extreme destinations. Hidden cultures. Extraordinary humans. Drew Binsky travels to every country on Earth to discover what connects us all.

overview: Jeremy, Jazzy, and Stu go on musical adventures together in Creation Station. Join them for story songs about the friends they meet and places they travel in a world full of imagination.

overview: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

title: The Howard Stern Show
overview: Each episode spotlights Howard Stern's boundary-pushing humor, social commentary, and intimate conversations – all with his iconic voice and unique perspective. Recognized as one of the best interviewers in the business, the series also features Howard's in-depth, candid conversations with celebrities, musicians, and more.

title: Pain in the Neck
overview: After the apocalypse hits Hollywood, Ruby’s acting career is dead, her landlord’s a chatty zombie, and her roommate, Helena, is a vampire that drinks her blood in exchange for protection. As the two big personalities clash, Ruby and Helena struggle through self-tapes, jealousy, and sharing a bedroom. Ruby and Helena’s arrangement should be simple– it shouldn’t involve falling in love.

title: Building Buffalo
overview: The story of the laborers, tradespeople, architects and contractors who built the Bills' state-of-the-art stadium.

title: The Fit Bit Killer
overview: British woman Caroline Crouch is murdered in Athens during an apparent robbery. Her husband Babis survives, but as leads go cold, troubling questions emerge.

title: The Sacred & The Profane
overview: In The Sacred and the Profane, an eight-hour course, Dr. Jordan B. Peterson explores Mircea Eliade’s ideas and the powerful ways sacred experience shapes human consciousness, meaning, and civilization itself. Drawing on comparative mythology, psychology, and religious traditions, the lectures reveal recurring archetypal patterns—from confronting chaos and undergoing transformation to establishing meaningful order—across cultures and history. Key themes include archetypal narratives, sacred centers and wilderness, hierarchies of meaning, the nature of recurring existential crises, and the ultimate role of sacrifice and voluntary responsibility in creating cosmos from chaos.

title: Rival on Ice, Lover in Bed
original_title: Rival on Ice, Lover in Bed
overview: At a university in Boston, the figure skating team boasts two star athletes: Nikolai Volkov—a dashing, wealthy playboy—and Caleb Hart—a talented, cheerful skater from an ordinary background. Their paths couldn't be more different; one relies on abundant resources and elite coaching, while the other relies on raw talent. Nikolai appears to be a womanizer but is actually gay, whereas Caleb is a wholesome, straight guy with a phobia of homosexuality. Clashing over their philosophies and personalities, they are notorious campus rivals. This is the story of how their lives intertwine...

title: Neagley
overview: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

title: Golden Axe
overview: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

title: Route 187
overview: Citizens combat urban violence until a bus driver and student's murders by thugs spark outrage, leading authorities to hunt the culprits captured on video.

title: Cathedrals
overview: A 17-year-old girl is found burned and dismembered in an empty lot in a middle-class neighborhood of Santiago, Chile. Due to police negligence, the crime goes unpunished until thirty years later, when the family manages to piece together the murder puzzle, revealing a forbidden relationship and a cruel truth.

title: The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition
original_title: The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition
overview: The series features ten celebrity-driven vehicles, each aligned with a charitable cause, embarking on a cross-country journey to raise awareness, drive fundraising, and activate local communities - transforming competition into contribution and the open road into a force for good. Best known for his iconic roles across film and television, Ian Ziering is a lifelong car enthusiast and committed philanthropist with longstanding ties to charitable and community-based initiatives. As host, he leads viewers through America's backroads and byways, celebrating the people, places, and causes that define the country's past and present - while connecting legacy stories with a new generation of audiences.

title: Cassie Workman is Witchy AF
overview: "Cassie Workman Is Witchy AF, an eight-part weekly, comedic documentary series hosted by Australian transgender comedian Cassie Workman, explores the history and philosophy of occultism and magic. Set in a fictional occult bookstore and featuring puppetry and practical SFX make-up, the show finds Workman diving into the worlds of “ritual magic, identity, demons, tarot, love, death and possible salvation,” while also exploring topics such as occultist Aleister Crowley and religious movement Santa Muerte." -them

overview: Fang Yuan, a ruthless demon-path cultivator, is betrayed and killed after centuries of scheming, then wakes up 500 years in the past in his younger body. Armed with his memories of the future and a lifetime of cunning, he sets out to claim the Spring Autumn Cicada, a legendary Gu worm that lets its owner relive the past, and to pursue eternal life by any means necessary. In a world where cultivation depends on raising and refining Gu worms, Fang Yuan trusts no one and sacrifices anything, and everyone, to climb the ranks.

title: Best Sex Ever
overview: Rebecca More interviews fascinating queers about their best sex ever.

title: Mafia Daddy: We Shouldn't Kiss
overview: Riley, a bullied college outcast, falls for Jasper, the campus heartthrob—only to be brutally humiliated after confessing his feelings. When mob boss Vincent steps in to save him, Riley is instantly captivated. But when his best friend Allen invites him home for the summer, Riley discovers a shocking secret: Vincent is Allen’s father. As their forbidden attraction grows, Riley and Vincent must risk everything to defy judgment, family, and the world around them. Can their impossible love survive?

title: Gemma Collins: Everything. All at Once.
original_title: Gemma Collins: Everything. All at Once.
overview: Gemma Collins has spent years living her life in the public eye. Known for her larger-than-life personality, unfiltered honesty and ability to turn even the most ordinary moment into an event, there is very little the world thinks it doesn’t know about Gemma. But behind the headlines is a woman trying to navigate life and the very real personal challenges that come with it: her relationships, her family, and her hopes for the future.

overview: Follows six designers living in Bihl Manor for 31 days while completing a renovation. They face elimination challenges testing their nerve and design skills as they transform the haunted mansion's spaces, pursuing a $50,000 cash prize.

title: Echoes Through Ink
overview: Bound by a dangerous prophecy hidden within ancient magical scrolls, a young scholar finds his destiny intertwined with two mysterious women—each carrying secrets of a forgotten era. As dark forces attempt to manipulate reality through mystical ink and forbidden art, the trio must decipher the hidden codes of the past before the empire collapses into chaos. Amidst palace intrigues, ancient curses, and rising conflicts, they must face painful sacrifices to protect the world and claim a love written in the stars.

Pierre was long presumed dead by Soraya, but he suddenly appears claiming to be Nina's husband. Shocked by his return, Nina collapses and suffers medical trauma, losing parts of her memory.

title: Without a Trace
overview:
The story follows Barbu, a man who lives a quiet life with his family in a secluded mountain village, far from the noise and chaos of the city. However, the safe haven he has built for his loved ones is suddenly threatened when a dark chapter from his past resurfaces.

As secrets come to light and old betrayals demand a price, Barbu is drawn into a dangerous spiral of revenge, forced to make difficult choices in order to protect the people he loves.

title: Shadows and Dust
overview: From the Peking Man to fugitive DB Cooper, Columbus' sunken Santa Maria and Cambyses II's missing armies, history's missing pieces are shrouded in mystery. As clues ignite public obsessions, investigators follow a trail through history to recover what has been lost. What is the truth behind these infamous disappearances? Can we ever hope to know the fate of these lost historic treasures?

title: Hollywood ReelTime
overview: A fast, smart, personality-driven entertainment news series covering the biggest stories shaping Hollywood, pop culture, and the national conversation.

title: High Value Target: The Hunt for Saddam
original_title: High Value Target: The Hunt for Saddam
overview: In 2003, John Nixon, a CIA analyst became the first American to positively identify and interrogate Saddam Hussein. During their time together, Nixon began to understand the potential consequences of the invasion, the humanitarian horrors and geopolitical turbulences that would follow Saddam's deposing.

Through personal stories and thoughtful conversations, each episode reflects on the people who inspire us, support us, and hold a special place in our hearts.

original_title: From Cold Palace to the Throne
overview: Framed and banished to the desolate Cold Palace by treacherous court politics, a sharp and resilient woman vows to reclaim her honor and exact revenge. To survive the deadly palace intrigues, she enters into a dangerous, high-stakes alliance with the enigmatic Emperor. As they navigate hidden betrayals and ruthless power struggles, a passionate yet conflicted romance unfolds between them—paving her vengeful path from an outcast concubine to the ultimate ruler of the throne.

title: Adapting
overview: A flaming wheelchair. A principal’s brand-new car. And one unforgettable exit. Sixteen-year-old twins Lennon and Lola Anderson are forced to leave behind the only life they’ve ever known after the death of their mother. Along with their father, Mel, they move to Halfway Bay, the picturesque coastal town where their mother grew up, hoping for a fresh start. But none of them are quite ready for what comes next. Smart, funny and fiercely independent, Lennon, who has cerebral palsy, is determined not to be known simply as “the disabled new girl.” At her new school, she soon finds herself caught between Joey, a lovable outsider who understands her in unexpected ways, and Dylan, Halfway Bay’s golden boy. Meanwhile, Lola discovers an unexpected passion for dance, while Mel begins rebuilding more than just an old seaplane. The Andersons may have escaped their old lives, but starting over is about to prove far more complicated than they imagined.

title: Mythical Kitchen

Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

overview: Zuhal Topal'la Yemekteyiz is a Turkish reality cooking competition in which five contestants take turns hosting dinner parties in their own homes throughout the week. Contestants score each other's food, presentation, hospitality, and hosting skills, while host Zuhal Topal also awards points. At the end of the week, the contestant with the highest overall score wins the grand prize. Blending cooking, strategy, entertainment, and personal stories, the show has become one of Turkey's most popular daytime programs.

title: En Hamarat Benim
overview: En Hamarat Benim is a Turkish lifestyle and competition show hosted by Kadir Ezildi. Each week, five contestants put their housekeeping skills, hospitality, and culinary talents to the test as they welcome competitors into their homes. Participants are judged on cleanliness, organization, presentation, and the quality of the food they prepare, while guests and the host closely evaluate every detail. Combining home improvement, cooking, and friendly rivalry, the series follows the contestants as they compete for the highest score and the grand prize.

title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut)
original_title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut)
overview: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band’s Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour has been called “one of the most unflinching acts of musical resistance in the nation’s history”. With the May 30 show filmed in its entirety and planned for release in four in-sequence segments through the end of the 2026, the Philadelphia Freedom Cut captures Springsteen as he “comes out swinging”.

overview: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

In the new competition series, we get to watch Bobby lead his hand-picked home team of extraordinary chefs — Antonia Lofaso, Michael Jenkins and Claudette Zepeda — against some of the country’s most acclaimed restaurant staffs. These dueling lines must execute a flawless dinner service for real diners in real time. If the visiting restaurant team prevails, they'll win $25,000.

Clooner’s Corner is a chaotic public-access-style comedy series hosted by the King of Farmington, Clooner.

Each episode he sits in his corner for a freewheeling “Show and Tell,” presenting random artifacts from the "Cloonerverse" and riffing on them with maximum energy, dramatic flair, and zero restraint. The series expands the "Cloonerverse" one unhinged monologue at a time.

title: The Pivot Podcast
overview: Former NFL stars Ryan Clark, Fred Taylor and Channing Crowder host weekly sit-down conversations with A-list stars, delivering timely discussions on important topics.

title: Unwell Summer Games
overview: During Unwell Summer Games, contestants will go head-to-head in a series of challenges that test their strength, strategy, and allegiances. Join Pepe Garcia, Suede Brooks, Hallie Batchelder, and many more for an unforgettable summer of drama, deceit, and questionable decisions. This is the summer event of the year—you won’t want to miss a second of the madness.

title: Fan Level Midnight: Devoted to The Office
original_title: Fan Level Midnight: Devoted to The Office
overview: Explore how the U.S. version of The Office grew from a ratings-challenged adaptation to one of the most enduring television series of its era. Traveling from the home of Dunder Mifflin in Scranton, Pennsylvania, to the soundstages in Van Nuys, California, the filmmakers also turn the camera toward the fans themselves.

overview: The best safari sightings, all in one place. It’s as close as you’ll get without being there. Epic encounters, amazing behaviour and fascinating info from an expert guide make this the safari of your life. The highest rated wildlife encounters are wrapped up in a reality-based game-drive. Keep your eyes peeled – in the African bush the most unexpected sighting is always just around the corner!

title: A Tale of Two Cities
overview: A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

title: Bad Boys Cancun
overview:
The Bad Boys are back and taking over Cancun for their wildest and most explosive season yet. A bold new group heads south of the border, bringing big personalities, bigger egos, unexpected alliances, heated rivalries, and nonstop drama to paradise.

With tensions running high and friendships put to the test, every Bad Boy will have to prove why he deserves his place in the house. The beaches are hot, but the Bad Boys are bringing even more heat.

Welcome to Bad Boys Cancun.

title: Japan's Wild Side
overview: Japan is famous for its rich traditions and futuristic cities, but it is also a nation bursting with unbelievable wildlife. On this journey from the archipelago’s harsh winters through the summer mating season, meet endemic species like bears, raccoons, crabs, flying squirrels, foxes and eagles. Witness never-before-seen footage of Japanese cranes’ courting ritual, the spawning of the endangered Japanese giant salamander, battles between Ezo sables, and the flight of the Sika deer.

Set in an alternate 2004 where Oprah Winfrey is president-elect, “FARPOINT” is a coming-of-age mystery drama that explores consciousness and the mutable nature of reality. Twin Peaks meets Wayward Pines.

Professor Neargarder explores what we know about diseases such as multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s, Huntington’s, and she digs into the wiring of people prone to epileptic seizures, and those suffering from mitochondrial diseases. And she analyzes the effects of traumas ranging from athletic head injuries to strokes.

For each disorder, she walks through the genetic and environmental factors that underlie the pathology, shares insight about the signs and symptoms to look out for, and looks at the latest research on treatment and cures. Building a better understanding of these disorders can help us minimize our risk factors, recognize symptoms, and ensure the best course of action for ourselves and those we love.

title: Second Chance Love
overview: In Second Chance Love, five pairs of first loves reunite for a two-week journey filled with nostalgia, emotional reflection, and intimate dates. Led by our hosts, they revisit their pasts, confront unfinished business, and rediscover what once brought them together. As they build new memories and lean on each other for support, one big question remains: will they rekindle the spark they once had or discover that love belongs in the past? Told only in the way Hallmark can, with heartfelt emotion, authentic connection, and just a touch of magic, this new, original series is a celebration of second chances and the enduring power of love.

title: Wild Dads
overview: In a rare visual masterpiece, "Fatherhood in the Animal Kingdom" offers a humanistic and scientific documentation of parental relationships in the animal kingdom. From penguins incubating their eggs under the snow to lions fiercely protecting their cubs, the film reveals the meanings of sacrifice, protection, and warmth in astonishing, instinctive situations. It is a work that combines science and emotion at their finest.
